name: money-bot
description: Money Bot — scaffold for human-approved UK/EU checkout handoff. Not production. No card numbers touch the agent.

MONEY_BOT_MCP_URL.title: Money Bot MCP URL
MONEY_BOT_MCP_URL.description: Money Bot MCP endpoint ending in /mcp. Local prototype: http://localhost:8787/mcp (wrangler dev). Deployed: https://money-bot.<account>.workers.dev/mcp. No secrets.

MONEY_BOT_MCP_AUTH.title: Money Bot Authorization header
MONEY_BOT_MCP_AUTH.description: Full Authorization header value sent to the MCP endpoint. Local prototype (ALLOW_TEST_AUTH=true, ENVIRONMENT=development in .dev.vars): 'Bearer test:<your-user-id>'. Production identity is not implemented yet (issue #4); without this header every tool call is rejected with 401.
